caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: transition, above range · 1d: range · 4h: range, near range top · 1h: transition, mid range · 15m: range, mid range. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.

timeframes.invalidation: A 1w close back below 94.91 would mean the breakout failed and price has reintegrated the range.
A 4h close above 107.86 would break the range top zone and invalidate the current range reading.
A 1h close outside 98.20-107.39 would invalidate the current range reading.
A 15m close outside 105.33-107.42 would invalidate the current range reading.
